fixed_execution_equivalence.scope: 3 exact bundled sources; fixed manual real partial fills and closes; not async throughput

limitations: Identical initial history and recipe, but asynchronous runs produce different subsequent trades/work. Rate difference is observed throughput, not a deterministic algorithm speedup.
Cumulative wall stages nest and include concurrent waits and final quiescence; do not sum them or attribute HTTP P95 to a stage without request correlation.
Order P95 is a separate gateway probe, not Pine decision P95. Final bar backlog includes the stop boundary.
Three qualified sources and 692 parameter sets; default event prefilter disabled. Memory storage capacity measurement; PostgreSQL correctness/recovery only.
Process working-set sums double-count shared pages. Short windows do not qualify sustained memory or 512/2048-bar history continuation.
Full JSON journal serialization and worker transport still exist. No interpreter upgrade or arbitrary-script capacity qualification.
